title: T90 (Tinyana) PNC - Sha'ar ha-Charsis — Why We Break a Keli Cheres at the Shidduch
hebrewTitle: שבירת כלי חרס בשעת השדוך — שני ענינים
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **"Ta'am al shevirat keli cheres bi-she'as ha-shidduch hu bi-shnei inyanim."** The reason we break a keli cheres at the time of the shidduch is *two-fold*. Because *be-emes tzrichin li-zaher me'oid me'oid she-loi le-gareish es ishtoi*: a man must be exceedingly careful never to divorce his wife — *ki amru Chazal* (Eruvin 41b): **"shloishah einam ro'im pnei gehinom... u-mi she-yeish loi ishah ra'ah."** Three do not see the face of Gehinom — and one of them is *one with a difficult wife*. **"Le-mai nafka minah — le-kabuli be-ahavah."** And the meforshim ask: why does the Gemara give *that* nafka minah specifically here, when just before it discussed *shloishah ma'avirin es ha-adam al daato ve-al daas koino* — and there it says *le-mai nafka minah le-mivei rachamei*? **The answer**: in *those* three (which override a man's mind), one *prays for rachamei* to escape them. But in *these* three (a difficult wife included) — *kabuli be-ahavah dayka* — accept it with love, *because the very enduring is what saves you from Gehinom*.

intermediate.en: **Ta'am**: shevirat keli cheres ba-shidduch = *shnei inyanim*. **Tzaroch lehi-zaher me-od loi le-gareish ishto**: **ערובין מא: "שלושה אינם רואים פני גיהנם... ומי שיש לו אשה רעה. למאי נפקא מנה? לקבולי באהבה."** *Lekabuli be-ahavah dayka* — eino mevei rachamei (כפי הקודם שם) ela mekabel ahavah, ki al-yedei zeh eino ro'eh pnei gehinom.

scholarly.he: [T2:90א] עירובין מא: — "ג' אינם רואים פני גיהנם"; אשה רעה → "לקבולי באהבה" (לא לבעי רחמי כקודם).

beginner.en: **Sha'ar ha-Charsis = the entrance to Gehinom.** *Ve-zehu bechinas shevirat keli cheres bi-she'as ha-shidduch* — for there was in Yerushalayim a *Sha'ar ha-Charsis*, the **Gate of the Potsherds**, where the broken pieces of clay vessels were thrown (Rashi there). **"Ve-yatzata el gei ben Hinnom asher pesach Sha'ar ha-Charsis"** (Yirmiyahu 19:2). And *Gei Ben Hinnom* is the bechinah of *Gehinom* itself — Chazal (Sukkah 32b; Eruvin 19a) tell us **"shtei tmaroth yesh be-Gei Ben Hinnom, ve-oleh ashan mi-beineihem — ve-zehu pis-cha shel Gehinom."** Two date-palms with smoke rising between them — that is the *very entrance* of Gehinom, and it sat opposite the *Sha'ar ha-Charsis* of Yerushalayim. So when we break a keli cheres at the chuppah, we are *literally breaking a piece of the Sha'ar ha-Charsis* — the gate that stood opposite Gehinom — *into the wedding hall*.

intermediate.en: **שבירת כלי חרס = שער החרסית**: ירושלים — sha'ar ha-charsis ("היו משליכין שם שברי חרסים" רש"י). **ירמ' יט:ב "וְיָצָאתָ אֶל גֵּי בֶן הִנֹּם אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הַחַרְסִית."** Gei Ben Hinnom = Gehinom. **סוכה לב: ; עירובין יט. "שתי תמרות יש בגי בן הינום, ועולה עשן מביניהם — וזהו פתחה של גיהנם."** Shevirat keli cheres ba-chuppah = shever-mi-Sha'ar ha-Charsis = pesach Gehinom mu-vei le-tzeil ha-chasunah.

scholarly.he: [T2:90ב] ירמ' יט:ב; סוכה לב: ; עירובין יט. — שער החרסית בירושלים מול "שתי תמרות" שבגי בן הינום = פתחה של גיהנם.

beginner.en: **The two messages whispered into the chasan's ear by the breaking shard.** *Ki me-ramzin lo ba-zeh shnei inyanim*: through the breaking of the keli cheres — which IS the bechinah of Sha'ar ha-Charsis = pesach Gehinom — two opposite-but-intertwined messages are signaled to the chasan, *whichever wife he is about to be matched with*. **(1) If she turns out to be an *ishah ra'ah*** — *ti-zaheir le-val tivgod bah, rak tekabel be-ahavah* — *do not betray her, accept her with love* — *ki al-yedei zeh einecha ro'eh pnei Gehinom*. The very pesach Gehinom you see at the chuppah is your warning that the *only* gate-pass past Gehinom (in the case of a difficult wife) is *kabbalah be-ahavah*. **(2) If she turns out to be an *ishah toivah*** — *da u-zechor, ki yesh Gehinom*, ve-loi tih'yeh nimshach achar ta'av-secha, *ve-tikadeish atzmecha ka-ra'oui*. Even with a wife who is sweetness — *zachor tizkor she-yesh Gehinom*. The same shard that says "endure" to the man with the difficult wife says "sanctify" to the man with the easy one. *Ve-chol zeh me-ramzin lo al-yedei shevirat keli cheres, she-hu bechinas Sha'ar ha-Charsis, she-hu bechinas pis-cha shel Gehinom, ve-al kein al-yedei shevirat keli cheres me-ramzin lo shnei ha-inyanim ha-na"l*.

intermediate.en: **Shnei ha-mesarim**: (1) **Ishah ra'ah** → *ti-zaheir lo li-vgod bah, rak kabel be-ahavah* → einech ro'eh pnei Gehinom. (2) **Ishah toivah** → *da ve-zechor she-yesh Gehinom, lo tih'yeh nimshach achar ta'av-secha, kadeish atzmecha ka-ra'oui*. Shnei inyanim u-meiramzin al-yedei keli ha-cheres = Sha'ar ha-Charsis = pesach Gehinom.

scholarly.he: [T2:90ג] שני רמזים: (א) אשה רעה → קבל באהבה → אינך רואה פני גיהנם; (ב) אשה טובה → זכור שיש גיהנם → קדש עצמך. שניהם ע"י שבר כלי החרס = פתחה של גיהנם.
